    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the surrounding color-3 rectangular frame.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    # The isolated color-3 mark inside the frame is the center of the pattern.
    marks = [(r, c) for r, c in cells
             if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1]
    if not marks:
        return out
    cr, cc = marks[0]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            if (r, c) == (cr, cc):
                continue
            d = max(abs(r - cr), abs(c - cc))
            out[r][c] = 4 if d % 2 == 1 else 2
    return out
"
